description: §66.2.4 (S451): `<g:Guess | not=.Yes/>`, `let <h:Guess|not=.No/>`, `let <name:string | not=not/>` parse; the cells hold a value or `not` and `is given` follows their writes.
rationale: §66.2.4 (S451): "The type after `:` in an opener is any type expression, including a union: `T | not` and `T | U` are written with `|`, bare … A front end that rejects a union type in an opener has a parser bug, not a language rule."
